title: कक्षा दशको नेपाली पाठ्यपुस्तकमा समाविष्ट व्याकरणका अभ्यास
nepali: कक्षा दशको नेपाली पाठ्यपुस्तकमा भएका व्याकरणका अभ्यासहरूको अध्ययन गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार गरिएको यो लेख गुणात्मक अनुसन्धानको पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययनमा आधारित छ । कक्षा दशको नेपाली पाठ्यपुस्तकलाई अध्ययनको मूल सामग्री मानी सोही पुस्तकबाट तथ्यहरू सङ्कलन गरी वर्णन विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । व्याकरणका प्रत्येकपाठ्यवस्तुलाई तालिकीकरण गरी वर्णनात्मक एवम् व्याख्यानात्मक तरिकाले विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । सोहीअनुसार कक्षा दशको नेपाली पाठ्यपुस्तकमा धातु, शब्दवर्ग, लेख्यचिन्ह, काल–पक्ष, मूल–व्युत्पन्न शब्द, उपसर्ग–प्रत्यय, द्वित्व, समास, वर्णविन्यास, वाक्यका प्रकार, पदसङ्गति, वाक्य संश्लेषण–विश्लेषण, कारक–विभक्ति र वाच्यसम्बन्धी व्याकरणका अभ्यासहरूराखिएका छन् ।मूल र व्युत्पन्न, वर्णविन्यास, स्वर वर्ण र अक्षर संरचना, वाच्यसम्बन्धी व्याकरणका अभ्यासलाई सम्बन्धित पाठसँग जोडिएको छ भनेधातु, लेख्यचिन्ह, पदसङ्गति, भाव, वाक्य संश्लेषण र विश्लेषण, कारक र विभक्ति, लघुतावाची, समूहवाची र सिङ्गो शब्दका अभ्यासलाई सम्बन्धित पाठसँग जोडिएको छैन । व्याकरणका अधिकांश पाठ्यांशलाई मूल पाठसँग नजोड्नु शैक्षणिक दृष्टिले पाठ्यपुस्तकको कमजोरी मानिन्छ ।
american_english: Prepared with the objective of studying the grammar exercises contained in the Grade 10 Nepali textbook, this article is based on library research within qualitative methodology. Taking the Grade 10 Nepali textbook as the primary material of the study, facts were collected from that book and descriptively analyzed. Each grammatical topic was tabulated and analyzed in a descriptive and explanatory manner. Accordingly, grammar exercises related to verb roots, word classes, punctuation marks, tense-aspect, root and derived words, prefixes-suffixes, reduplication, compounding, orthography, sentence types, agreement, sentence synthesis-analysis, case-inflection, and voice are included in the Grade 10 Nepali textbook. While grammar exercises related to root and derived words, orthography, vowels and syllable structure, and voice are linked with the respective lessons, exercises on verb roots, punctuation marks, agreement, mood, sentence synthesis and analysis, case and inflections, diminutives, collective words, and single-word substitutions are not linked with the respective lessons. Failing to connect most grammatical units to the main reading texts is considered a pedagogical shortcoming of the textbook.

informal_english: Written to look into the grammar exercises in the Grade 10 Nepali textbook, this paper is based on library research within qualitative methodology, eh. Taking the Grade 10 Nepali textbook as the main source material, facts were gathered right from the book and descriptively analyzed. Every single grammar topic was tabulated and analyzed in a descriptive and explanatory way. Along those lines, the Grade 10 Nepali textbook includes grammar exercises on verb roots, word classes, punctuation marks, tense-aspect, root and derived words, prefixes-suffixes, reduplication, compounding, spelling rules, sentence types, agreement, sentence synthesis-analysis, case-inflection, and voice. While exercises on root and derived words, spelling rules, vowels and syllable structure, and voice are linked up with their respective lessons, exercises on verb roots, punctuation marks, agreement, mood, sentence synthesis and analysis, case and inflections, diminutives, collective words, and single-word substitutions aren't linked to the lessons at all. Not tying most of the grammar components into the main reading texts is definitely a real pedagogical shortcoming of the textbook.
